title: Pan-Seared Chicken with Lemon and Herbs
description: A French-inspired dish featuring a crispy-skinned chicken, infused with the bright flavors of lemon and herbs.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Stir in the lemon juice and chopped thyme.
Remove the chicken from the oven and brush with the garlic-lemon butter.
Serve hot and garnish with additional thyme, if desired.
